claim: Pre-FOMC drift: since 1994 more than 80% of the US equity premium was earned in the 24 hours before scheduled FOMC announcements (Lucca-Moench, NY Fed blog, 2012).
quote: We show that since 1994, more than 80 percent of the equity premium on U.S. stocks has been earned over the twenty-four hours preceding scheduled Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) announcements
title: The Puzzling Pre-FOMC Announcement Drift (Liberty Street Economics)

claim: Pre-FOMC drift essentially disappeared after 2015 in extended sample to Dec 2019 (Kurov, Wolfe, Gilbert, Finance Research Letters 2021); authors suggest reduced uncertainty.
quote: the pre-FOMC drift essentially disappeared after 2015 in both announcements accompanied by press conferences and announcements not accompanied by press conferences.
title: The disappearing pre-FOMC announcement drift (abstract)

claim: Lucca-Moench find no reversal in days after scheduled FOMC meetings in their own tests (Table 12), i.e. the pre-drift return is not given back.
quote: do not find any evidence of a reversal in subsequent days or lower returns prior to FOMC days.
title: The Puzzling Pre-FOMC Announcement Drift (author reply in comments)

claim: Index straddle returns around macro announcements are negative on average (long premium loses), except positive around FOMC meetings (OptionMetrics summary of academic paper; sample not shown on page).
quote: Risk premia in index option straddle positions are also negative around announcements, except that they are positive around Fed Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.
title: OptionMetrics research abstract on variance risk premia around macro announcements

claim: Reversal strategy on E-mini S&P 500 from 13:50 ET to close, opposite prior 24h return, averaged 0.18% net per FOMC announcement, Sharpe 0.36 (Oct 1997-Jan 2020, 180 announcements) - FOMC-day intraday reversal (CXO summary of Baglioni-Ribeiro).
quote: A reversal strategy trading E-mini S&P 500 from 13:50 EST to the close, opposite the prior 24-hour return, averaged 0.18% net per FOMC announcement with Sharpe ratio 0.36 (Oct 1997–Jan 2020; 180 announcements; trades at bid/ask).
title: Stock Market Return Reversal after FOMC Announcements (CXO Advisory)

claim: Raw GEX has a strong rank correlation with next-day realized vol on SPY (rho -0.36, n=1,971) but falls to -0.03 (p=0.18) after controlling for VIX and ATM IV (vendor/practitioner backtest, 8 years).
quote: After controlling for VIX and ATM IV, the GEX-only signal drops from rank correlation -0.36 (strong) to -0.03 (statistical noise, p=0.18).
title: GEX Backtest: 8 Years of SPY (FlashAlpha)
